description: This Java source file defines a class `IntegrationTestApplicationClientFactoryImpl` that extends `ApplicationClientFactoryImpl` and implements `IntegrationTestApplicationClientFactory`. It provides methods to create message senders and legacy command clients for integration testing with Hono, a messaging platform.

classes.name: IntegrationTestApplicationClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A test implementation of a client factory that creates message senders and command clients for integration testing.
